title: Sentinel evaluation harness for embeddings: stratified goldens, latency-weighted metrics, and drift sentinel
creator: Maya Patel
description: Build a production-facing offline evaluation harness ("Sentinel") for embedding and reranking endpoints that combines stratified golden corpora, latency-weighted quality metrics, and a rolling drift sentinel to catch regressions before deploy. This ticket scopes the end-to-end system: dataset curation (strata by domain/length/traffic), offline runner, nightly jobs, alerting thresholds, and canary gating hooks for production rollouts. Goal: provide a single signal suite that surfaces both quality regressions (recall/ndcg/rr) and operational regressions (95p latency, P50 token throughput) for embeddings + rerank stages.
acceptance_criteria: A1: Stratified golden sets created for top 6 customer domains (support, search, knowledge, commerce, legal, docs) with at least 250 queries each.
A2: Offline runner produces daily metrics: recall@k, ndcg@10, MRR, cosine stability, embedding cosine-distribution shift, and latency percentiles (P50,P95,P99) annotated by model variant.
A3: Drift sentinel implements rolling 7-day baseline and raises alerts on statistically significant drop in ndcg or mean cosine similarity (>3 sigma) or latency regression > 15%.
A4: Integration with Console: per-model dashboard tile, and alert links that include failing query samples and top contributing features.
A5: Canary gating hook implemented: if nightly sentinel triggers high-impact regressions, automated canary rollback flag is set and infra/PM are notified.
A6: Documentation and runbook added; three synthetic perturbation types (typo/semantic-paraphrase/long-prefix) included for regression repros.
A7: Performance budget check: nightly runner reports cost-per-1k-queries and flags if inferred token cost increases >10% compared to baseline.
A8: Unit and integration tests for the runner; CI job that runs small subset on PRs for model changes.
implementation_notes: Data: curate stratified goldens by sampling traffic logs + manual labels. Use consensus labelling for judge pairs; store gold sets in s3://redwood-embed-goldens/2025-02/ with manifest metadata.
Runner: build a re-usable python runner that can call embeddings endpoint and reranker pipeline locally and via Redwood Hosted API. Use async batching and respect rate limits.
Metrics: compute recall@1/5/10, ndcg@10, mrr, average cosine and cosine variance per-query; additionally compute latency P50/P95/P99 per-model and per-sequence-length bucket.
Drift detection: implement bootstrap-based confidence intervals and an EWMA anomaly detector for short-term spikes; persist baselines in timeseries DB (Prometheus/Influx).
Alerting: configure Console alerts and PagerDuty integration for high-impact regressions; include runnable repro link and candidate PR refs in alert payload.
Canary gating: wire alert status to rollout controller (A/B or canary) so that failing sentinel sets route to safe-model variant and pauses rollout.
Cost telemetry: fetch token-count and inference-cost estimates per-run to compute cost-per-1k-queries; add to nightly report.
Synthetic perturbations: implement three transforms (character-level noise, semantic paraphrase via LLM, long-prefix concatenation) and include in nightly runs to detect brittle embeddings.
Testing: add small fixture goldens to the repo for PR-level smoke tests; nightly job uses full goldens and stores historical deltas for trend analysis.
Dashboard: create per-model cards showing trending ndcg and latency with drilldowns to failing samples and model build metadata (git sha / quantization profile).
